resources.string: This is the most alarms the app can hold (%1$d). To add a new one, delete an alarm you no longer need.
Choose a PIN (4 to 8 digits). When locked, alarms can only be switched on and off. You need the PIN to change them.
The PIN must have 4 to 8 digits.
The two PINs are not the same.
Notifications are blocked. The alarm screen cannot appear. Tap to allow.
Exact alarms are not allowed. Alarms may ring late. Tap to allow.
Full-screen alarms are not allowed. Tap to allow.
Battery saving may stop alarms. Tap to allow the app to run.
While the phone is in use, the alarm screen cannot cover other apps. Tap and allow \"Display over other apps\".
Locks together with the home screen: Settings → Lock there.
Shows the next alarm. Make it bigger to see all alarms. Tap to open the alarms.
